registerAssessment: Mostly reads as competent Spanish prose written by someone fluent, but the repeated untranslated English words ('fundamentals', 'internals', 'gotchas') and consistent straight-quote typography around the course name break the illusion of a native Spanish-speaking developer's writing. Evidence: 'Esto es fundamentals, e intencionalmente se detiene antes de async avanzado, trabajo profundo de objetos e internals más complicados del lenguaje' leaves three English nouns untranslated inside an otherwise fluent Spanish sentence.
